artifacts.title: Architecture spine
artifacts.summary: 15 binding architecture decisions (AD-1..15) fixing the invariants: files-only, Docusaurus, two content planes, AI-in-CI, thin provider abstraction, task contracts, L1 retrieval, hash provenance, PR-only persistence, deterministic validation, build-time views, i18n, local search, static deploy, injection boundary. Plus deferred items and seed.

artifacts.title: Solution architecture (MEGOLDAS)
artifacts.summary: The 35-section final SAD: information architecture, repo model, canonical/generated models, AI generation, routing, retrieval, recruiter/interview/special-question designs, Mermaid, automation, drift, security, deployment modes A/B/C, CI/CD, cost, risks, roadmap phases, PoC description, migration checklist. EN with Hungarian executive summary and MEGOLDAS sections.

artifacts.title: Content architecture
artifacts.summary: Final taxonomy (docs/source 00-14, generated views, diagrams), critique of the draft structure, naming conventions, full frontmatter metadata schema for canonical and generated pages, link/diagram conventions, EN/HU translation strategy, generated-content policy.

artifacts.title: AI architecture
artifacts.summary: Generation plane design: 4 ~40-line provider adapters behind one Protocol, YAML policy routing with privacy hard-pin to local, Level-1 deterministic retrieval with explicit L2/L3 escalation boundaries, 9-contract catalog, per-artifact pipeline with single repair retry, failure/degradation modes.

artifacts.title: Automation architecture
artifacts.summary: GitHub ingestion (diff, classification, manifest, impact), deterministic hash-based drift detection, four CI/CD workflows with security posture, incremental regeneration rules.

artifacts.title: Security architecture
artifacts.summary: Six trust zones, 13 modeled threats (prompt injection, MDX execution, Mermaid XSS, pwn-request CI, supply chain, secret leakage, misinformation, cross-provider exposure), least-privilege tokens, provider data-handling stance, incident runbook, per-control simplicity check.

artifacts.title: Knowledge base wiki
artifacts.summary: 33-file cross-linked distillation: 6 foundations, 7 platform pages, 8 patterns, 5 practices, 4 decision frameworks, glossary, INDEX.md and llms.txt entry points, plus the six full SADs under 50-platform-architectures. 0 broken links at build.

artifacts.title: Validation report Gates A-F
artifacts.summary: All six gates PASS with the evidence trail; explicit VERIFIED-BY-EXECUTION vs NOT-EXECUTED split; honest skill-usage statement.

artifacts.title: Runnable PoC
artifacts.summary: Docusaurus 3.10.2 starter proving the five mandated scenarios by execution: dual docs instances, Mermaid, InterviewPrep component, recruiter page with real sha256 provenance, 4 provider adapters + privacy-pinning router, 3 contracts and prompts, 3 pipeline scripts, 2 workflows. node_modules/build excluded from archive; npm install restores.
